claim_boundary: This artifact is a data-class no-go for determinant-only transition compilers. It is not a no-go for the phase-coupled operator and proves no transition concentration, seed, endpoint, moment, density, or intervals.

remaining_target.statement: retain theta or the signed collision residual in a repeated-difference transition operator and prove phase-coupled concentration or cancellation

transition_entropy_theorem.boundary: this is not a no-go theorem for the phase-coupled operator and proves no transition concentration, seed, endpoint, moment, density, or prime-interval theorem
transition_entropy_theorem.dyadic_entropy: when q~N and R~S with S>>N, a nonempty interior dyadic block contains asymptotically S/N shear choices up to absolute constants
transition_entropy_theorem.endpoint_floor: the shear exponent tau-rho is at least xi+1/3-2rho; at the full endpoint it is xi+2mu-1/3>=23/75
transition_entropy_theorem.scoped_no_go: rational labels, determinant signs, and dyadic sizes alone leave power-sized shear entropy; subpower transition concentration in that data class must retain theta or an equivalent phase anchor
transition_entropy_theorem.tail_coordinate: for delta=|alpha-p/q| in the next-convergent shell, theta=(1/(q delta)-R)/q lies in (0,1) and delta=1/[q(R+theta q)] exactly
transition_entropy_theorem.torsor: for fixed primitive (p,q) and orientation s, all solutions of Pq-pR=s are (P0+tp,R0+tq), t in Z
